physicalDescription: Early 50s Caucasian male with a receding hairline and dark hair tied back in a small ponytail. Pale complexion and a constantly furrowed brow. Hazel eyes peering skeptically behind frameless glasses. He wears a casual blazer over a t-shirt, trying to maintain an academic vibe. Average height with a slight paunch. Often has one hand rubbing his chin thoughtfully and the other holding a microphone. Gives off an air of smug intellectualism, head tilted as if always about to correct someone.
profileBanner: A podcast studio in a dim garage. A black horse silhouette (the Dark Horse) painted on the wall with conspiracy webs stretching from it. Microphones and camera equipment lie scattered among biology textbooks and protest signs. A shelf displays horse dewormer bottles (ivermectin) like trophies. The window shows an Evergreen College campus sign with vines choking it. The atmosphere is smoky, with question marks rising like smoke signals to the ceiling.
